because: Counterexample on c51cdc9: the scan cut each call at its first ')', so drop_verdict(packet_len.min(u64::MAX), drop_reason::VFR_ANOMALY) was invisible and an unlabelled drop passed; a non-literal reason was skipped silently.
statement: A drop reason has a metric label exactly when the XDP program passes it to drop_verdict; the source scan that checks this sees every drop_verdict call whatever its length argument and refuses a reason it cannot name as drop_reason::IDENT.
